description: Bornes de recharges Ecocharge77 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Marc Boitel. Data on the locations of the charging points of the Ecocharge77 network in the format of the Order of 4 May 2021. Coverage: Marc Boitel. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations Ecocharge77" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Marc Boitel. Its keywords include irve-77, irve, ecocharge77, bornes-electrique. The listing shows 2023-03-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
